# GLM dependency

Upstream: https://github.com/g-truc/glm
Release: 1.0.3 (tag commit 8d1fd52)
Archive: https://codeload.github.com/g-truc/glm/tar.gz/refs/tags/1.0.3
Archive SHA-256: 6775e47231a446fd086d660ecc18bcd076531cfedd912fbd66e576b118607001

The `glm` headers and `copying.txt` are copied without source modifications.
CMake propagates the same constructor initialization configuration to consumers.
Do not enable globally aligned types or global handedness/depth-range switches;
ICE uses explicit projection variants and packed GPU upload storage.
